title: [Windows] Left/right arrow keys do not navigate between open submenus
body:

- [x] I agree to follow the [Code of Conduct](https://github.com/electron/electron/blob/main/CODE_OF_CONDUCT.md) that this project adheres to.
- [x] I have searched the [issue tracker](https://www.github.com/electron/electron/issues) for a bug report that matches the one I want to file, without success.

### Electron Version

42.4.1

### What operating system(s) are you using?

Windows

### Operating System Version

Windows 11 25H2

### What arch are you using?

Other (specify below)

### Last Known Working Electron version

n/a

### Does the issue also appear in Chromium / Google Chrome?

I don't know how to test

### Expected Behavior

(Using windows 11 in emulated environment (parallels) on mac arm64 arch)

Steps to reproduce:

Launch an Electron app with a native menu
Press Alt to focus the menu bar — the first menu header is highlighted
Press ↓ to open the File submenu
Press →

Expected: The File submenu closes, the Edit submenu opens, and its first item is selected.

See paint and notepad for examples of windows apps that behave this way.



### Actual Behavior

Actual: Nothing happens. The → key has no effect while a submenu is open.
